process previsit.outreach v1
Subject: case
Stages: [previsit]
Start: cycle
Uses: [rule/previsit.missing_items]
Requires: [previsit@1]
Variables: [{Name=case_ref, Type=Code, IsInput=true}, {Name=practice_zone, Type=Code, IsInput=true}, {Name=missing, Type=Integer, IsInput=false}]
Windows: [{Name=contact_hours, ZoneVariable=practice_zone, Days=[Monday, Tuesday, Wednesday, Thursday, Friday], From=09:00, To=18:00}]
Scenarios: [nothing is missing, a reply after the first reminder closes the stage, three reminders without a reply end at the front desk, the front desk resolves a case after the reminders are used up, an unknown delivery goes to the front desk, which sends the case back to the loop, a transient failure of the reminder is retried inside the window, a reminder that is not available hands the whole stage to the front desk, a reminder the practice is not entitled to ends at the front desk after three days, a zone the host cannot resolve raises a task instead of a contact, a reminder waits for the next opening of the contact hours, the requirements cannot be read at all, the requirements fail for good, the requirements fail on every attempt and nobody answers the task, a negative count decides nothing and goes to the front desk, a read without a count makes the rule fail and goes to the front desk, a case that came without its zone is suspended at the reminder, never failed and never routed]
step cycle
  Kind: Loop
  Stage: previsit
  Routes: [{Label=body, Target=check}, {Label=onExhausted, Target=escalate_final}]
  Loop: {MaxIterations=3}
step check
  Kind: Read
  Stage: previsit
  Routes: [{Label=next, Target=assess}, {Label=onError, Target=escalate}, {Label=onNotAvailable, Target=escalate_final}]
  Port: intake.requirements
  Retry: {MaxAttempts=3, Backoff=exponential, Initial=00:00:30, Max=00:05:00}
  Inputs: [{Name=case, Variable=case_ref}]
  Outputs: [{Name=missing_count, Variable=missing}]
  InputNames: [case_ref]
  OutputNames: [missing]
step assess
  Kind: Decide
  Stage: previsit
  Routes: [{Label=on:none, Target=done}, {Label=on:some, Target=send}, {Label=onNoDecision, Target=escalate}, {Label=onError, Target=escalate}]
  Rule: previsit.missing_items
  RouteField: action
  Facts: [{Name=missing, Variable=missing}]
  InputNames: [missing]
step send
  Kind: Action
  Stage: previsit
  Routes: [{Label=next, Target=reply}, {Label=onError, Target=escalate}, {Label=onNotAvailable, Target=escalate_final}, {Label=onNotEntitled, Target=escalate_final}, {Label=onUnknown, Target=escalate}]
  Port: messaging.reminder
  Delivery: AtMostOnce
  IsContact: true
  Window: contact_hours
  Retry: {MaxAttempts=3, Backoff=exponential, Initial=00:01:00, Max=00:10:00}
  Inputs: [{Name=case, Variable=case_ref}, {Name=missing, Variable=missing}]
  InputNames: [case_ref, missing]
step reply
  Kind: Wait
  Stage: previsit
  Routes: [{Label=next, Target=cycle}, {Label=onTimeout, Target=cycle}]
  Event: case.reply_received
  Correlation: case_ref
  Timeout: {Duration=1.00:00:00}
  InputNames: [case_ref]
step escalate
  Kind: HumanTask
  Stage: previsit
  Routes: [{Label=on:resolved, Target=cycle}, {Label=on:unreachable, Target=closed}, {Label=onTimeout, Target=closed}]
  Queue: front_desk
  Outcomes: [resolved, unreachable]
  Show: [case_ref, missing]
  Timeout: {Duration=3.00:00:00}
  InputNames: [case_ref, missing]
step escalate_final
  Kind: HumanTask
  Stage: previsit
  Routes: [{Label=on:resolved, Target=done}, {Label=on:unreachable, Target=closed}, {Label=onTimeout, Target=closed}]
  Queue: front_desk
  Outcomes: [resolved, unreachable]
  Show: [case_ref, missing]
  Timeout: {Duration=3.00:00:00}
  InputNames: [case_ref, missing]
step done
  Kind: End
  Stage: previsit
  Result: previsit_closed
step closed
  Kind: End
  Stage: previsit
  Result: previsit_unreachable
